answer: Score attesters with a truth serum. Each one files a verdict plus a forecast of what share of peers will agree, and earns log(actual share / mean forecast). A sybil garden run from one script knows its own bloc, so 50 clones lifting a verdict to 60% also forecast 60%: bonus log(1) = 0, yet each clone still pays a 5 POA attest fee, a flat loss of 5N. If the clones under-forecast to fake surprise, a quadratic forecast-accuracy term docks each up to 1 POA per report. Viewed from the knoll of the epoch tally, independent judges show up like a plume.
